newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Q3 GDP due Dec 10, analysts expect decline.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Q3 GDP due Dec 10, analysts expect decline.

text.p: Switzerland's gross domestic product data for the third quarter will be released December 10 at about 0700 GMT, a spokesman for the Swiss Federal Statistics Office said in response to an enquiry.

Economists expected GDP for the third quarter to be weak, with markets expecting a drop of around 0.7 percent versus the second quarter of 1996. Economists said Swiss consumption remained slack, a major factor behind the weakness.
GDP in the second quarter compared with the first quarter showed a drop of 0.9 percent on an annualised, seasonally adjusted basis.
Second-quarter GDP fell by 0.5 percent compared with the same quarter of 1995. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
